post.title: ## 📚 Paid Remote Internship for College Students – Educational Content Writing
post.body:
I'm looking for one college student to join me as an Educational Content Writing Intern for a learning-focused project.

💰 Internship Details

* Stipend: ₹3,000 per month
* Duration: To be discussed
* Working hours: 3 hours per day
* Work mode: 100% remote
* Schedule: Fixed daily working hours, agreed upon before joining

📝 What You'll Do

* Research educational topics and explain concepts in simple language.
* Write learning materials, study notes, and educational articles.
* Help create content for school students.
* Follow content briefs, revise drafts, and meet deadlines.

✅ Requirements

* Must be a college student.
* Must have a working laptop and stable internet connection.
* Must be comfortable attending Google Meet sessions with the camera ON.
* Good writing and research skills.
* Willingness to learn and accept feedback.

💳 Payment

A stipend of ₹3,000 per month, paid through [specify UPI or bank transfer].

📩 How to Apply

Please comment with the following details:

1. Name
2. College course and current year
3. Do you have a working laptop and stable internet? (Yes/No)
4. Are you comfortable with camera-on Google Meet sessions? (Yes/No)
5. Have you written educational content before? (Yes/No)

Please don't share personal contact or financial details publicly. I'll contact suitable applicants through Reddit.

This is a practical opportunity to gain educational content-writing experience and build your portfolio.[same Internship offer I posted on Internsala.]
